description: Crop composition manifest for replaying staged identity edits without another image API call.
composition_method: paste edited crops onto the exact base-image bounding boxes after verifying original crop coordinates
notes: Run scripts/compose_fixture_frame_crops.ps1 with ProjectSlug and FrameId to reproduce the full formal frame locally.
Use -DetectOnly to re-check crop coordinates when the base or crop assets change.
Stage2 crops must differ from their base crops, and Stage3 must be a pixel-faithful compose of the edited crops at the declared bboxes.
